verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Framer plugins can insert images, layers and code components or modify anything on the canvas. The native External Agent connection gives Claude Code, Cursor and Codex direct access to the canvas, components and CMS. Agent edits land on a reviewable branch, and agents can create, update and delete CMS items. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven design writes, and detailed docs on which canvas and design operations the external agent connection can perform (CMS write is explicit; canvas write is stated only as 'direct access').
